PROTECTIONOFWOMEN

1. GENERAL

Protection of women is important because women are a vulnerable or subordinated group, particularly in connection with the many cases of violence against women who become victims.

Furthermore, in the National Action Plan for the Elimination of Violence against Women of 1999, it is stated that women as mothers of the nation and children as successors of the nation are creatures created by God Almighty, so they must be protected and their honor, dignity and self-esteem must be safeguarded in a reasonable and proportional manner, both legally, economically, politically, socially and culturally without distinguishing ethnicity, religion, race and class.

Although efforts have been made to protect women and there are also government policies through laws and regulations that have firmly formulated efforts for the protection of women, including efforts to protect women victims of violence, in reality the intensity or number of violence against women in East Kutai Regency is still high while services and protection for women in East Kutai Regency have not been carried out optimally. Empirically in East Kutai Regency, an important factor that has influenced the process of prevention and protection of women so far is that in existing laws and regulations, procedures and mechanisms for prevention and protection are not firmly regulated.

Empirically in East Kutai Regency, an important factor that has influenced the process of prevention and protection of women so far is that in existing laws and regulations, procedures and mechanisms for prevention and protection are not firmly regulated.

Protection of women is important because women are a vulnerable or subordinated group, particularly in connection with the many cases of violence against women who become victims.

1. GENERAL

Protection of women is important because women are a vulnerable or subordinated group, particularly in connection with the many cases of violence against women who become victims.

Furthermore, in the National Action Plan for the Elimination of Violence against Women of 1999, it is stated that women as mothers of the nation and children as successors of the nation are creatures created by God Almighty, so they must be protected and their honor, dignity and self-esteem must be safeguarded in a reasonable and proportional manner, both legally, economically, politically, socially and culturally without distinguishing ethnicity, religion, race and class.

Although efforts have been made to protect women and there are also government policies through laws and regulations that have firmly formulated efforts for the protection of women, including efforts to protect women victims of violence, in reality the intensity or number of violence against women in East Kutai Regency is still high while services and protection for women in East Kutai Regency have not been carried out optimally. Empirically in East Kutai Regency, an important factor that has influenced the process of prevention and protection of women so far is that in existing laws and regulations, procedures and mechanisms for prevention and protection are not firmly regulated.

PROTECTIONOFWOMEN

1. GENERAL

Protection of women is important because women are a vulnerable or subordinated group, particularly in connection with the many cases of violence against women who become victims.

Furthermore, in the National Action Plan for the Elimination of Violence against Women of 1999, it is stated that women as mothers of the nation and children as successors of the nation are creatures created by God Almighty, so they must be protected and their honor, dignity and self-esteem must be safeguarded in a reasonable and proportional manner, both legally, economically, politically, socially and culturally without distinguishing ethnicity, religion, race and class.

Although efforts have been made to protect women and there are also government policies through laws and regulations that have firmly formulated efforts for the protection of women, including efforts to protect women victims of violence, in reality the intensity or number of violence against women in East Kutai Regency is still high while services and protection for women in East Kutai Regency have not been carried out optimally. Empirically in East Kutai Regency, an important factor that has influenced the process of prevention and protection of women so far is that in existing laws and regulations, procedures and mechanisms for prevention and protection are not firmly regulated.

CONCERNING

PROTECTIONOFWOMEN

1. GENERAL

Protection of women is important because women are a vulnerable or subordinated group, particularly in connection with the many cases of violence against women who become victims.

Furthermore, in the National Action Plan for the Elimination of Violence against Women of 1999, it is stated that women as mothers of the nation and children as successors of the nation are creatures created by God Almighty, so they must be protected and their honor, dignity and self-esteem must be safeguarded in a reasonable and proportional manner, both legally, economically, politically, socially and culturally without distinguishing ethnicity, religion, race and class.

Although efforts have been made to protect women and there are also government policies through laws and regulations that have firmly formulated efforts for the protection of women, including efforts to protect women victims of violence, in reality the intensity or number of violence against women in East Kutai Regency is still high while services and protection for women in East Kutai Regency have not been carried out optimally. Empirically in East Kutai Regency, an important factor that has influenced the process of prevention and protection of women so far is that in existing laws and regulations, procedures and mechanisms for prevention and protection are not firmly regulated.
